title: 《一块钱》
english_summary: A rainy night at a tiny noodle shop where nobody has come in. A cat appears at the door, then a man who is one kuai short of a bowl of noodles. Nobody explains anything — at HSK 1 nobody can.
_content_comment: One beat per line, ‘NAME：text’ with a fullwidth colon. Beat indices are 0-based and are what panels[].bubbles[].beat refers to; INSERTING A LINE MEANS RE-INDEXING THE PANELS.
content:
下雨了。
我在饭店里。
妈妈做饭。
今天没有人来。
小美：你看！
一只猫在外边。
它很小，也很冷。
你：你想吃什么？
你：你想喝水吗？
猫不说话。
我给它牛奶。
它都喝了。
一个人来了。
他要面条儿。
妈妈：十块钱。
他有九块。
他不说话。
你：没关系。
你：妈妈，我有一块钱。
妈妈：好。吃吧。
他吃面条儿。
猫看他。
他给猫一个鸡蛋。
小美：猫喜欢他。
他和猫都不说话。
明天他会来吗？
english_content:
It started raining.
I'm in the noodle shop.
Mum is cooking.
Nobody came today.
Look!
There's a cat outside.
It's small, and cold too.
What do you want to eat?
Do you want some water?
The cat doesn't speak.
I gave it milk.
It drank all of it.
Someone came in.
He wanted noodles.
Ten kuai.
He has nine.
He doesn't say anything.
It doesn't matter.
Mum, I have one kuai.
Alright. Eat.
He eats the noodles.
The cat watches him.
He gives the cat an egg.
The cat likes him.
Neither he nor the cat says a word.
Will he come tomorrow?
_vocabulary_comment: Every word is HSK 1 (data/hsk1-vocab-snapshot.json, cumulative). Zero reach words. The level is what shaped the plot: HSK 1 has no 因为, no 但是 and no 告诉, so nobody in episode 1 can explain anything — the whole story is told in actions, food and numbers, which is exactly what HSK 1 has in abundance (十块钱, 九块, 一块钱).

questions.question: Why could the man not pay the full price for the noodles?
options: He had nine kuai, but the noodles cost ten.
He had left his money at home.

questions.question: What did the learner give Mum?
What did the man share with the cat?

Warm colour manhua panel from The Rainy-Day Noodle Shop. 小美, a bright ten-year-old with a short ponytail and a too-big apron, spinning round on a stool and pointing at the doorway.
Warm colour manhua panel from The Rainy-Day Noodle Shop. A soaked calico cat sitting in the rain just outside the light, absolutely still, looking in.
Warm colour manhua panel from The Rainy-Day Noodle Shop. Close on the cat: fur flat with rain, one paw lifted off the wet ground, eyes enormous.
Warm colour manhua panel from The Rainy-Day Noodle Shop. The cat and the reader’s outstretched hand, the cat not moving toward it, rain streaking the frame.
Warm colour manhua panel from The Rainy-Day Noodle Shop. A chipped saucer of milk set down on the wet step, the cat’s nose almost touching it.
Warm colour manhua panel from The Rainy-Day Noodle Shop. The saucer empty and the cat licking its mouth, now sitting inside the doorway with its tail curled round its feet.
Warm colour manhua panel from The Rainy-Day Noodle Shop. A big man in a soaked work jacket standing in the doorway, shoulders down, face mostly hidden by the light behind him.
Warm colour manhua panel from The Rainy-Day Noodle Shop. The mother’s hand flat on the counter beside a steaming bowl, the man’s hand opposite it holding coins.
Warm colour manhua panel from The Rainy-Day Noodle Shop. Overhead close-up: nine coins spread on the wooden counter, a small gap where a tenth should be.
Warm colour manhua panel from The Rainy-Day Noodle Shop. The mother pushing the bowl across the counter with two hands, her face unreadable and kind.
Warm colour manhua panel from The Rainy-Day Noodle Shop. The cat sitting on the stool beside the man, watching him eat with total attention.
Warm colour manhua panel from The Rainy-Day Noodle Shop. The man’s big hand lowering half a boiled egg from his own bowl down to the cat.

Warm colour manhua panel from The Rainy-Day Noodle Shop. Final plate: the man and the cat side by side at the counter from behind, rain running down the plastic sheeting, neither of them looking at the other.
